name: El Cubo de Tierra del Vino (Spain)
description: White field with a red diagonal band from the lower hoist to the upper fly, charged with three green discs at the upper hoist and a red Greek cross at the lower fly.
history: The governing committee of the Diputación of Zamora, in ordinary session on 14 April 1999, approved the heraldic arms and municipal flag of El Cubo del Vino; the flag is rectangular, of proportions 2:3, formed of a white cloth with a red diagonal stripe from the lower hoist corner to the upper fly corner, with three green circles in the hoist quarter and a red Greek cross in the fly quarter.
